items.reason: A gentler retinol strength to start with, in place of the 1% serum, since this is your first retinol and your skin looks dry.
A gentle, active-free cleanser that won't add to dryness.
A ceramide moisturizer to support a skin surface that looks low in moisture and to cushion the retinol.
A tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides, needed daily with retinol and helpful for keeping the look of uneven tone from deepening.

response.routine_note: I removed the 30% peel and the 1% retinol because pairing them is likely to irritate dry skin, and irritation can leave deeper skin tones looking darker and more uneven. Start the 0.3% retinol at night two or three evenings a week over moisturizer, wear the SPF every morning, and if the dark patches on your cheeks persist or change, a dermatologist is the right person to look at them.
